lines.text: Many learners say: We had a nice weather today.
Better: We had nice weather today.
Weather has no a or an.
Good weather! We had good weather.

data.wrong: We had a nice weather today.
data.why: Weather has no a or an.

native.hook: weather に a をつけていませんか？
native.tip: weather は数えられない名詞。a はつけず、nice weather と言う。
native.caption: “We had a nice weather today.”と言っていませんか？😅 weather は数えられない名詞なので、a はつきません。“We had nice weather today.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“good weather”。weather に a は不要。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Weather is uncountable, so do not use a.
en.caption: Do you say this? “We had a nice weather today.” 😅 Weather is a noun you cannot count, so it takes no a. The natural way is “We had nice weather today.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
